notes:
CRM notes / call snippets: 
- Mid-market SaaS (product-focused customer support platform).
- Primary ask: hosted API for fast time-to-market + predictable streaming for agent UI. Later evaluate Dedicated if unit-cost at scale improves.
- Latency SLO: <1.5s first-token on median and 99th under target workload (live prod mix). Streaming + tool-calling (KB lookup, ticket create) required.
- Quote from Sr. PM: "Users abandon chat when agent AI takes >1.5s — this is non-negotiable."
- POC so far: 7-day POC completed with sample traffic (10k msgs/day). Observed 95th first-token ~0.9s, but 99th spikes to 1.8-2.2s during bursts.
- They use a heavy tool-calling pattern: every 3rd turn triggers KB retrieval + optional ticket creation via our webhook. Need stable tool-call latency under 200ms to meet overall SLO.
- Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, KMS integration for envelope encryption. EU data residency for EU customers.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate; open to committed capacity if 20-30% cost savings vs hosted, but procurement needs clearer TCO.
- Roadmap: If POC meets SLOs with streaming and tool-call reliability, move to a 6-12 month Dedicated pilot for top 10 accounts.
- Internal contacts: Sr. PM (Aisha Kapoor), CTO (Daniel Park), Lead Eng (Tom Reynolds).
